purpose: The pager for a multi-view app: one dot per page, the current one solid, drawn at the same spot the Fields skin draws its dots (centre y 968 of 1080, 12px, 22px pitch). Weather, Calendar, Habits, Todo and Focus consume it; Fields draws its own in SVG at the same geometry.

states.recipe: Renders nothing: one page has no pager, and reserving the space would push content for no reason.
Full opacity; the other dots sit at 35 percent of the parent's text colour, so the widget inherits ink from the app and never names a colour of its own.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not draw dots at the disc's bottom edge
antiPatterns.why: below y 1000 on a 1080 panel the dots sit inside the bezel shadow; the previous 6px dots at 3.5 percent from the bottom were invisible on the round devices

antiPatterns.rule: Do not make the dots tappable
antiPatterns.why: paging is the vertical swipe; a tap target this small at the disc edge is a false affordance
